51603359.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to SHP2 (unknown origin) by SPR analysis
51603359.references_previous: Reference 7: Bivona, T. G. Dampering oncogenic RAS signaling. Science 2019, 363 (6433), 1280–1281.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) (7). The binding affinities of SHP2 to various compounds were measured in the BIACORE T200 SPR system. SHP2 from the Pharmaron prep was homogenized in buffer S (20 mM HEPES-Na, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP-Na and 1 mM EDTA, pH 7.5), diluted in 10 mM sodium acetate (pH 5.0) and coupled to the CDMS00 sensor chip (Xantec) by the EDC/NHS method in HBS-EP+ buffer (Cytiva, catalogue no. BR100826). The SPR experiment was proceeded in the multiple cycle kinetics mode with compounds in serial dilution in buffer H (20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5% DMSO and 0.05% Tween-20, pH 7.5). The association and dissociation lengths were 60 s and at least 360 s. The BIACORE evaluation software 3.2 was used for kinetics analysis by applying the 1:1 Langmuir binding model.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5% DMSO, 0.05% Tween-20, pH 7.5
